Short title and commencement

UNIVERSITY OF PESHAWAR (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
UNIVERSITY OF PESHAWAR
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the
University of Peshawar Act, 1974
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 16th October, 1996]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/96/17131, dated
16‑10‑1996.‑‑The University of Peshawar, (Amendment)
Bill, 1996, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North‑West
Frontier Province on the 30th September, 1996 and assented to by the Governor
of the North‑West Frontier Province on the 14th October, 1996 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North‑West Frontier
Province.
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be called the University of
Peshawar (Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 21 of Act II of 1974

UNIVERSITY OF PESHAWAR (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
UNIVERSITY OF PESHAWAR
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the
University of Peshawar Act, 1974
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 16th October, 1996]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/96/17131, dated
16‑10‑1996.‑‑The University of Peshawar, (Amendment)
Bill, 1996, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North‑West
Frontier Province on the 30th September, 1996 and assented to by the Governor
of the North‑West Frontier Province on the 14th October, 1996 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North‑West Frontier
Province.
2. Amendment of section 21 of
Act II of 1974.‑‑In the University of Peshawar Act, 1974 (N.‑W.F.P.
Act II of 1974), in section 21, in subsection (1):‑‑
(a) for clause (v), the following
shall be substituted, namely:
"(v) The Secretary to
Government of the North‑West Frontier, Education Department, or his
nominee not below the rank of an Additional Secretary; and
(b) after clause (v), as so
substituted, the following new clauses shall be inserted, namely:
"(va) The Secretary to
Government of the North‑West Frontier, Finance Department, or his nominee
not below the rank of an Additional Secretary;
(vb) The secretary to Government
of the North‑West Frontier Services and General Administration
Department, or his nominee not below the rank of an Additional
Secretary;".
